data.long_description:
Oria - a luxury project from Dubai's leading property developer Emaar, located in the picturesque Dubai Creek Harbour neighbourhood. The complex has 20 floors and offers a wide range of exquisite 1-3 bedroom apartments, decorated with the latest trends in interior design. Convenient layouts ensure optimal utilisation of space.

On-site amenities include children's and adult swimming pools, indoor and outdoor gyms with fitness area, children's playground, yoga studio and a beautifully landscaped garden with barbecue and recreational areas.

Oria enjoys a prime location close to Dubai's key locations. Shopping centres, restaurants, entertainment venues and business districts are in close proximity. Dubai Square shopping mall is within walking distance, Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport and Ras Al Khor Nature Reserve are all within 10 minutes, while JBR Beach and Dubai Marina are 25 minutes away.

Oria is where contemporary style meets elegance and comfort to provide residents with an unrivalled lifestyle. Impressive architecture and unique design make this residential development an ideal choice for those seeking luxury living in one of Dubai's most prestigious neighbourhoods.
